scope: Independent saved-byte and source-code re-audit of the research-only H-Rank-4 artifact merged by PR #74. This is not a model experiment, holdout evaluation, score, organizer receipt, or submission authorization.

reference_data.footprint_authenticity: Owner-mirror only; organizer authentication is not established.
reference_data.lattice_authenticity: Pinned local registered reference only; this is not a complete or organizer-authenticated live registry.

literal_uniqueness_gate.rule: Stop if more than 70% of final dots lie within 3 px of any one registered raster; correlation and overlap must be checked on the pre-placement surface and final dots.
literal_uniqueness_gate.disposition: STOP: the literal >70% overlap rule is exceeded against the pinned lattice even when counting all 5,761 file positives; the in-footprint-only result is 99.9787%. No exception or exemption is applied.

validator_discrepancy.original_generator: Reported outside_footprint_is_nan=true after passing an all-true footprint; this did not test the actual owner-mirror footprint.
validator_discrepancy.check_submission_py: Reported format_valid=true but also outside_is_nan_official_text=false and ok_to_upload=false; outside-NaN is not marked a hard requirement by that compatibility report.
validator_discrepancy.strict_validate_tif_py: Failed outside_is_nan: 0 of 7,111,787 outside pixels are NaN.
validator_discrepancy.interpretation: The strict local result is a format diagnostic against an unauthenticated owner mirror, not an organizer ruling. The contradictory permissive status is not submission approval.

generator_and_run_card_review.fault_mask_source: The generator calls synthesize_fault_mask; it creates synthetic line segments rather than loading authenticated competition faults or the organizer catalogue.
generator_and_run_card_review.footprint_source: The generator sets footprint = np.ones((H, W), dtype=bool), so it treats the entire raster as in-footprint and writes finite values everywhere.
generator_and_run_card_review.initial_uniqueness_scope: Only two locally cached GEMSDOE36 rasters; no lattice or complete registry. The reported correlations were computed on the final raster, not a saved pre-placement surface.
generator_and_run_card_review.run_card_dot_claim: The original how_it_differs_from_repo field claimed 30,000 dots; the saved TIFF contains 5,761 positive cells across the whole grid.
